services.name: Courtyard gardens
services.blurb: Small walled gardens with brick, ferns and a fountain, planted for deep shade and summer humidity.

services.name: Garden design for shade
services.blurb: A drawn plan for the dappled light under live oaks, with every plant named and placed.

services.name: Azalea and camellia care
services.blurb: Pruned right after spring bloom, fed for acid soil, so next March they flower again.

services.name: Coastal and marsh-edge planting
services.blurb: Salt-tolerant grasses and shrubs for island lots that take wind, spray and sandy soil.

services.name: Irrigation and drip
services.blurb: Drip for beds and pots, zones set by sun and shade, plus a rain sensor for storms.

services.name: Brick and tabby paths
services.blurb: Old Savannah brick and shell paths laid on a base that drains after a downpour.

services.name: Landscape lighting
services.blurb: Soft uplights in the oaks and low path lights, warm enough for an evening on the porch.

services.name: Seasonal cleanup
services.blurb: Oak leaves, fallen moss and storm limbs cleared, beds cut back and mulched with pine straw.

services.name: Hurricane prep and storm cleanup
services.blurb: Loose limbs and pots secured before a storm, debris hauled and beds restored after it.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our courtyard off Jones Street gets maybe two hours of sun. Celeste planted cast iron plant, holly fern and climbing fig on the back wall and moved the old fountain to where you can hear it from the kitchen. It finally feels like a room.
reviews.name: Margaret L.

reviews.text: Nothing would grow under our big oak, just bare sand and roots. They worked around the roots by hand, no tilling, and now there is a fern bed with a little stone path through it.
reviews.name: Dwayne C.

reviews.text: Our lot backs onto the marsh and everything we planted turned brown from the salt. They switched us to muhly grass, wax myrtle and saw palmetto. Two summers now and it looks better every year.
reviews.name: Ellen B.

reviews.text: They came the day after the storm warning, tied down the planters and pulled the hanging baskets inside. Afterwards they hauled two loads of limbs.
reviews.name: Ray N.

reviews.text: Path lights along the brick walk and two soft lights up into the oak. My husband and I sit outside after dinner now, which we never did before.
reviews.name: Gloria F.

reviews.text: I was told my azaleas were too old to save. They cut them back hard after bloom, explained it would look rough for a summer, and this spring they were covered in flowers.
reviews.name: Thomas E.

proof.guarantee: Shade plants we install that fail in the first year with normal watering are replaced once.
